sloka: स ताम् अभ्यवदत् विप्रः पुत्र ईप्सुम् पुत्र जन्मनि ।तव कुक्षौ महाभागे सु पुत्रः सु महाबलः ॥१-७०-३४॥
transliteration: sa tām abhyavadat vipraḥ putra īpsum putra janmani ।tava kukṣau mahābhāge su putraḥ su mahābalaḥ ॥1-70-34॥

translations.english: 'O Great lady a child of high prowess, lustre and virtues is growing in your womb. In a short time this glorious son carrying with him the poison (administered to you) will be born. O Lotuseyed lady, do not grieve'.
